status: Method review complete; coordinator owns implementation, tests and version-guarded application
method: Explicit nominal INR fixed discount rate for a retrospective stationary reference scenario
basis: The user delegated research/demo numerical method choices. Fourteen percent is a round selected scenario hurdle, not an observed issuer WACC, borrowing cost, country-risk estimate or return forecast. It discounts INR cash flows and exceeds the zero nominal INR terminal-growth assumption. No decomposition can be inferred from a direct hurdle.
uncertainty: There is no issuer-risk calibration. A useful reference stress range is 10% to 18%, with zero terminal growth and all other stationary assumptions held fixed; this is a scenario range, not a confidence interval. Future actual margins, reinvestment, financing and asset values can differ substantially.
